verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily adverse media screening, and says matches are routed to analysts for review with AI-performed supporting research and a case management workspace. That establishes the core screening-and-review flow. The docs do not show adverse-media matches presented with linked source evidence or categorized by risk type. Missing for 10: documented linked source articles/evidence on adverse-media matches, adverse-media risk categories or taxonomy, an adverse-media-specific review UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories

citations.quote: Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening, ensuring screening on both existing and new customers.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
